quote: Considering pathogenicity, 89.3% (CI: 88.9–89.6%) had majority consensus, and 81.0% (CI: 80.5–81.4%) had complete agreement.
quote_location: Results, Abschnitt „Variant interpretations in ClinVar are highly concordant“, Druckseite 1119 (PDF-Seite 2)

further_quotes.quote: Our data set included 27,224 variants classified by two or more ClinVar submitters. These spanned 1,713 genes and totaled 74,065 classifications from 429 ClinVar submitters.
Considering actionability, 96.7% of variants (CI: 96.5–96.9%) reached majority consensus, and 94.1% (CI: 93.9–94.4%) had complete agreement among all submitters
Our pathogenicity analysis considered three groups: positive (identical to the set defined above), uncertain (VUS), and negative (benign and likely benign).
If at least two-thirds of the classifications were in the same group (i.e., 2 of 2, 2 of 3, 3 of 4, 4 of 5, 4 of 6, etc.), the variant was said to have majority consensus
There were 20,160 variants with multiple classifications from clinical testing alone, and 57% of these (11,535) had multiple submissions from 2014 or later.
further_quotes.location: Abschnitt „Combined effect of interpretation source and age“, Druckseite 1122 (PDF-Seite 5)

further_quotes.quote: with 98.4% (CI: 98.2–98.6%) of variants having majority consensus and 97.2% (CI: 96.8–97.5%) reaching complete agreement (Figure 5).
Concordance is calculated on an actionability basis (see text).

observations: Die Werte 81,0 % und 89,3 % beziehen sich auf drei Gruppen (P/LP, VUS, LB/B), nicht auf die fünf Klassen; die Werte der klinischen Teilmenge ab 2014 (97,2 %, 98,4 %) auf zwei Gruppen (Aktionabilität: P/LP gegen VUS/LB/B, Legende Figure 5). Der Quellenkatalog nennt 81,0 % als „Fünf-Klassen vollständige Übereinstimmung“; das deckt sich nicht mit dem Text (Befund des Reviewers, CRITERIA.json M1d, ACC-18). Ein Fünf-Klassen-Wert steht in der Arbeit nicht. Die vollständige Übereinstimmung nach K-M1d-4 (alle Einreichungen dieselbe der fünf Klassen) ist strenger und deshalb nur bedingt vergleichbar; Yang et al. schließen benigne Polymorphismen aus (Methods).
